name: effects_particle_self_stop
description: Test 16 with the EF13 emitter contract. Loop budget (flag A 0x02): one burst of ceil(curve[0]) per loop, aged by its burst age; Stop(0) (delayed) when n reaches the loop count; inactive when the last particle dies (life 3 s at 0.5 s: burst age 0.5, ends on update 6). Count 2.2 makes 3. A Start(1) that does not start reads inactive after update 1. A start delay of 0.375 s at 0.25 s delays the burst to update 2 (age 0.125). Rate emitter (no bits): 8/s at 1/16 s, loop count 1: 8 particles, Stop(0) on update 17 when P passes 1, inactive when the last dies. Flag 0x08 holds the rate emitter at its last loop. Plain (0x04) never self-stops; a delayed Stop(0) plays out, Stop(1) ends at once. Start(1) does not restart a finite emitter.
